title: MV i need help with srd_menubackgrounds

posts.author: Deleted member 270129
posts.body: i am using SRD_MenuBackgrounds to spice up the default ui in my game, I have a item called "Compendium" which basically works as a encyclopaedia and I used the CGMV_Encylopedia plugin for this, ideally I would like it to be a menu instead of a item but that only seems possible in the mz version of this plugin, as you can see in the plugin parameter's the help file says to input the name for the scene and I put "CGMVEncyclopedia Scene" which is the plugin command to open the encyclopaedia menu. but as you can see in the compendium menu the background is just the games overworld.
